name: Electromechanical Energy Conversion Laboratory
description:
Transformers - parameter characterization through open circuit and short circuit test, parallel operation of single phase transformers, three phase transformer connections
DC machines - speed control of separately excited DC machines with armature voltage control and field current control
Induction motor - parameter characterization of 3-phase induction motor through no load test and blocked rotor test, V/f control, operation of single phase induction motor
Synchronous machines - synchronization with three phase grid, performance characterization
